Shared by Google Pay Standard and Express. Enter the API base URL, including its path (for example /api/). 
Phone on Wi-Fi: http://192.168.178.42:4000/api/ 
Android Studio emulator: http://10.0.2.2:4000/api/ 
Hosted backend: https://demo.example.com/api/ 
On a phone, localhost means the phone itself. Use your computer’s LAN address to connect without USB forwarding.
Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL with a valid host and port, without credentials, query or fragment.
Backend URL saved for both Google Pay pages.

Backend unavailable: %1$s
%2$s
%3$s
Change the address under Backend URL in the main menu. Merchant discovery requires GET /ui/config at the same origin.
localhost refers to this Android device. Use your computer’s LAN address, or connect by USB and run adb reverse tcp:%1$d tcp:%1$d.
10.0.2.2 reaches the computer only from the Android Studio emulator. On a phone, use the computer’s LAN address.
Check host, port and API path. For a LAN backend, use the same Wi-Fi, bind the server to 0.0.0.0 or its LAN address, and allow the port through the firewall.
